features.feature: A call is transcribed on the computer as it goes, the transcript ready seconds after it ends; a failure falls back to a full pass, and a failed one shows Failed with `transcribe.error`

A call has one language: pinned for it, the only one allowed, or detected once from its first sentences among the allowed ones (Ukrainian and Russian apart), then kept for the whole call and in its meta.json for a retranscription (re-decided when the allowed ones no longer include it); the first utterances, decoded before the decision, keep the language they were decoded in; a language pinned for a call applies to it alone
Silence gives no made-up text; on speakers the others aren't duplicated as Me
Remote voices become Speaker N or the names Teams lights; one other person names the whole remote track
A transcription server (another Echo or OpenAI-compatible) takes the utterances; when it is down this computer's model takes over
A long call transcribes and the computer stays usable

On speakers the mic's echo of the others is found during the call (once they have talked about 30 s, two looks 15 s apart agreeing) and the stretches of the mic it explains along their whole length aren't transcribed; the user's own words, a short word inside the echo or talking over the others, are; the app's log says the delay, gain, correlation and seconds skipped; found and skipped, and the same echo in the call's last minutes, nothing is decoded again at the end, otherwise the call's echo cancellation decodes the mic again at the end as before
